We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions, using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order.

We have applied 1914393 to target, got two precursors: "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1" and "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". That's first reaction.

Now need to apply template 1914394 to each of those? The order says use templates in this order, so second reaction should use 1914394 on one of the precursors from previous step. We attempted applying 1914394 to first precursor but got no result. Applied to second precursor got products: "ClCCl" and "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1". So second reaction splits the second precursor into two: a dichloromethane? Actually "ClCCl" is dichloromethane (CH2Cl2). And "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1" is a dehalogenated version (no Cl on phenyl). So second reaction yields those.

Now third reaction must use template 1914395 on some intermediate(s). We need to get final precursors that are simple or buyable. We need to apply 1914395 to maybe "FC1CN(Cc2ccccc2)C1" or "ClCCl". Let's get template 1914395.
